question: Should CodexBar permanently expose privacy-first Share Stats actions in both the status menu and Settings?
rationale: The patch is technically credible, but it adds a substantial new user-facing workflow whose product fit and ongoing maintenance cost cannot be inferred from tests or proof; VISION.md reserves that choice for maintainers.

options.title: Approve local sharing
options.body: Accept the local image and text export as a permanent first-party CodexBar workflow after required checks finish.

options.title: Approve one entry point
options.body: Keep the export implementation but expose it only in the status menu or Settings to reduce permanent interface surface.

options.title: Decline the surface
options.body: Keep CodexBar focused on glanceable in-app usage and omit a first-party sharing workflow.

recommendation.title: Approve local sharing
recommendation.body: Accept the local image and text export as a permanent first-party CodexBar workflow after required checks finish.

likelyOwner.reason: Repository ownership and the explicit VISION.md sign-off requirement make steipete the best available owner for this product choice.
